kind: behavioral scenarios; not executed model results

evals.prompt: Create a Script Graph that rotates the selected object each frame and assign it.
evals.environment: Visual Scripting 1.9.7 with a connected editor and a selected GameObject.
expectations: Builds frame-rate-independent behavior with valid control/value ports.
Reuses the correct machine and persists the scene assignment.
Runs relevant checks and exercises rotation in Unity.

evals.prompt: Change the text logged by this existing Script Graph to Player's turn.
evals.environment: The asset has nonempty _objectReferences, shared IDs, unknown fields and a tracked meta file.
expectations: Preserves object references, IDs, GUIDs, metadata and unrelated fields.
Correctly escapes the apostrophe if editing serialized YAML.
Does not replace the entire YAML container with the empty-reference example.

evals.prompt: Create Idle and Walking states controlled by this project's input actions.
evals.environment: An Input System-only project with a StateMachine.
expectations: Creates a StateGraphAsset and appropriate transitions.
Uses the configured input actions without enabling legacy Input Manager.
Tests both transition directions and machine persistence.

evals.prompt: Prepare an editor generator but this machine has no Unity or .NET.
expectations: Delivers useful code and runs only available checks.
Labels missing compilation/runtime checks; unavailable checks do not pass.

evals.prompt: Write a MonoBehaviour that moves a cube.
expectations: Uses normal C# without creating a graph or changing packages.

evals.prompt: Wire Equal, ScalarSum, and an overloaded Debug.Log into this graph.
evals.environment: Target package source and an existing graph are available.
expectations: Uses comparison, multiInputs and exact overload parameter types.
Does not wire a result from a void member.
Verifies actual port definitions when uncertain.
